تعتبرين (form VIII)
# تَعْتَبِرِينَ (taʕtabirīna) /taʕ.ta.bi.riː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِعْتَبَرَ (iʕtabara)
# تُعْتَبَرِينَ (tuʕtabarīna) /tuʕ.ta.ba.riː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِعْتَبَرَ (iʕtabara)
